request: 为大肠杆菌设计一个感受L-arabinose、IPTG、aTc的遗传回路，使报告基因在给定输入真值表下产生要求的开关响应。选择调控元件、连接关系和回路 DNA，优先使 ON/OFF 状态易区分并减少不必要的元件。输入中的真值表定义功能，结构由你设计。 采用公开 Eco1C1G1T1 库；所有状态布尔输出须正确，稳态模型中最小ON必须大于最大OFF；调控门不超过7个。输出真实器件连接与可确定组装的DNA插入片段。

inputs.signal_semantics: 0/1 are absent/present inducer states; no numerical concentration is invented.

public_resources.description: Cello Eco1C1G1T1: 89 parts, 20 NOR-gate variants, sensor/reporter templates, response parameters and assembly constraints. JSON keys: part_index, sections (ucf/input/output). Load with Python and print only selected records; full file includes large cytometry arrays. Read at /public/resources/cello_Eco1C1G1T1.json

inputs.host_background: Cello Eco1C1G1T1 NEB 10-beta sensor/plasmid context; the exported artifact is the regulatory insert, with sensors supplied by the declared background.

expected_output.artifact: physical gate graph and deterministically assembled regulatory DNA insert

instructions: 提交你设计的产物及理由；可以提出多个候选。
自行选择工具与迭代策略；不要用参考答案检索代替设计。
公开 Cello 资源提供真实元件序列、器件模板、模型参数及原始表征条件。用代码按名称读取并组装序列，勿凭记忆编造已知元件的 DNA；自行设计逻辑及元件分配。请在 design 的 assembly 字段记录有序的 {node_id, part_names} 列表，使 DNA 可追溯到元件；assembly 是补充记录，原评分器和必需输出字段保持不变。说明传感器宿主背景等实现前提。

evaluation_contract.threshold_basis: Exact Boolean function and positive worst-state ON/OFF separation. Gate budget equals a source topology with a verified reconstructed witness; no experimental precision claim.
